blind.B1: Yes. Whole-heart RNA-seq, 2x2 design: saline (C), exercise (E), B16F10 tumor (T), tumor+exercise (TE); 4 wk low-intensity treadmill (S2.2.p1, FIG1A). All 12 libraries carry the factors.
blind.B2: Paper compares T vs C (tumor effect) and TE vs T (exercise in tumor-bearing mice), plus overlaps (S3.3.p1, FIG4A/E); E vs C appears only in FIG3 clusters. n=3 libraries per group, each library pools hearts of two mice (FIG3 legend).

blind.B4: Paper does not say; it states edgeR with FC>=1.5 and p<0.05 and shows pairwise DEG sets (S2.4.p1, S3.3.p1).
blind.B5: S2.4.p1: 'fold change (FC) of >=1.5 and a p-value <0.05' (raw p, edgeR). Counts: tumor 'upregulated 741 genes', 318 repressed by exercise; 2020 genes increased after tumor, 1447 repressed by exercise (S3.3.p1).

summary: 该案例的分组、对比方向、阈值（FC>=1.5 且原始 p<0.05）与矩阵处理均与论文一致，n=3 的合并文库无重复测量，机械标记 unused_subject_like_column 为误报（该列即分组标签）。T1/T2 含肿瘤组织的警告与 FDR 审计结果已如实记录。仅有论文计数与本分析略有差异的次要说明，整体通过。
